name: boolean_not
description: Evaluate Python not on Boolean literals, matched control copies the input literal.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(100):
 b=bool(i%2);name=random.choice(['flag','ready','active','done','valid','enabled','ok','visible'])
 prefix=f'In Python, {name} = {b}. '
 items.append({'prompt':prefix+f'The value of not {name} is', 'answer':' '+str(not b)})
 control.append({'prompt':prefix+f'The value of {name} is', 'answer':' '+str(b)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
